youtube_description:
Along with the official trailer for Wish, Disney revealed the rest of the voice cast!  It includes Victor Garber as Sabino, Natasha Rothwell as Sakina, Jennifer Kumiyama as Dahlia, Evan Peters as Simon, Harvey Guillén as Gabo, Ramy Youssef as Safi, Niko Vargas as Hal, Della Saba as Bazeema and Jon Rudnitsky as Dario.
